limits_and_unchecked_scope: This is engineering correctness/identity evidence from tiny CPU checkpoints and two-token generations. No capability/accuracy, full-size GPU run, publication, real released-model validation or real heldout test execution is certified.

No real course test records were evaluated. Test journal probes use explicitly authored synthetic rows and genuine neural generation; deliberate exceptions occur before the next model call to simulate interruption, without canned model answers.

Actual three-row private/safe equivalence ran on the recorded7eeba loader source. The final7e1a latest-guard source was independently executed for the guard and exact loader/scorer/generation-loop equality was checked. The report does not relabel historical output artifacts as generated by a later version.

The marker guard verifies sequential ancestry on one local canonical protocol path with that marker/journal state. This probe does not establish an interprocess compare-and-swap lock, distributed/cross-host lease, enforcement across copied protocol files or malicious marker editing.

Manifest metadata and hashes bind known checkpoint/export identities but are not signatures or independent training-origin attestations for arbitrary third-party models. Probe exports have a known actual random-training and validation-selection lineage.
Safe export supplies model evaluation/inference payloads; optimizer/sampler/RNG resume remains the private latest.pt training artifact. Actual private latest resume was used in this probe.

Core scoring/generation/Journal/objective/model semantics were unchanged and the prior11 resolved counterexamples were not rerun. Their earlier limits remain applicable. The two legal notice corrections remain open/deferred in the separate legal report.

No source/data/course edits, real heldout test generation, paid work or commit was performed. Writes were only this reviewer’s new report, snapshots and necessary small private CPU/source identity fixtures.
